Alpha tokens (--ah-surface, --ah-border, --ah-toggle) are white at 5–12% and only read correctly over --ah-shell. They are not swatchable in isolation.

Known gaps

Hover and active resolve to the same #3F3F46, so an open helper looks identical to a hovered one. There is no focus ring on any control. Both are recorded in proposals/0002, not fixed here — this page records what ships.
